stem_book: Two blocks A (mass 4m, at distance 2ℓ from the axis) and B (mass m, at distance ℓ from the axis) are connected by a cord passing around a frictionless pulley which is attached to a rotating frame (see figure). The coefficient of friction between each block and the frame is μ. Determine the value of ω at which the blocks start sliding radially. (a) √(3μg/7ℓ) (b) √(5μg/9ℓ) (c) √(5μg/7ℓ) (d) √(μg/3ℓ)
reason: stem now states the friction μ on both blocks (shown only in the figure)
work: A tends outward, B inward: 8mω²ℓ = T + 4μmg, T = mω²ℓ + μmg ⇒ 7ω²ℓ = 5μg ⇒ ω = √(5μg/7ℓ)
